key.name: activation
key.description: "click-or-hold" works like Windows: click the middle button to start scrolling and click again to stop, or hold it down, move, and release. "hold" only scrolls while the middle button is held down; a quick middle-click is passed to the app as a normal middle-click.

key.name: speed
key.description: Multiplier for how fast pages scroll for a given distance from the starting point. 1.0 matches Windows (Microsoft Edge and Google Chrome).

key.name: vertical-only
key.description: Ignore sideways movement, so autoscroll only ever scrolls up and down.

key.name: pass-through-links
key.summary: Middle-click on links works as usual
key.description: When the mouse pointer is a hand (over a link or button), a middle-click goes to the app instead of starting autoscroll, so links still open in a new tab.

key.name: pass-through-text
key.summary: Middle-click on text works as usual
key.description: When the mouse pointer is a text cursor, a middle-click goes to the app instead of starting autoscroll (for example to paste). In web browsers the text cursor also shows over ordinary page text, so this stops autoscroll from starting there too.

key.name: pass-through-top
key.summary: Middle-click near the top of windows works as usual
key.description: A middle-click in the top part of a window (title bars, header bars, browser tabs) goes to the app instead of starting autoscroll, so middle-clicking a tab still closes it.

key.name: top-height
key.summary: Height of the top area, in logical pixels
key.description: How far down from the top edge of a window a middle-click still goes to the app, when pass-through-top is on.

key.name: pass-through-modifier
key.description: While this key is held, a middle-click always goes to the app instead of starting autoscroll.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.description: Middle-clicks in these apps always go to the app. Entries ending in ".desktop" are app IDs. Entries starting with "wmclass:" match a window's WM_CLASS and may use * and ? wildcards.

key.name: debug
key.description: Log why each middle-click did or didn't start autoscroll, and when it stops, to the system journal.
